beginner.summary: For analysts and business users new to Tableau. Covers the workspace, connecting to data, data types and roles, basic charts, filters, sorting and grouping, hierarchies, calculated fields, table calculations, maps, date analysis, parameters, dashboards, actions, stories, formatting, relationships and joins, extracts, publishing and the Desktop Specialist exam.
prerequisites: Comfortable with Excel tables and simple formulas
outcomes: Connect to data and build accurate charts and maps
Write calculated fields and table calculations
Build interactive dashboards with filters, parameters and actions
Publish and share work and prepare for the Desktop Specialist exam

days.topic: Tableau Overview, Products and Workspace Setup
subtopics: What Tableau is and where it fits
Tableau Desktop, Prep, Cloud, Server and Public
Installing Tableau Desktop or Tableau Public
The start page and connecting to sample data
The workspace: data pane, shelves, cards and marks
The course datasets: Superstore and HR data
days.lab_task: Install Tableau, connect to Superstore, build a first bar chart of sales by category, label every part of the workspace and save as a packaged workbook.
days.deliverable: Packaged workbook and a labelled workspace screenshot
checks: Opens on another machine with data
Shelves, cards and panes named correctly

subtopics: File sources: Excel, CSV and text
days.lab_task: Connect to a messy Excel file with the data interpreter, pivot month columns into rows, split a full name field, then connect to a PostgreSQL table live and as an extract.
days.deliverable: Data sources and notes on live and extract

days.lab_task: Build the same view with a field as discrete and as continuous, fix a postcode read as a number, change default aggregations and explain each pill colour.
checks: Switch a date between discrete and continuous
String type with a geographic role

subtopics: Pie and donut charts and their limits
Choosing a chart for the question
days.lab_task: Answer eight business questions about Superstore with the best chart for each, and explain why a pie chart is or is not suitable for two of them.
days.deliverable: Workbook with eight sheets and chart choice notes

days.lab_task: Build a top 10 products view that respects a region filter using a context filter, sort in several ways, group small categories into "Other" and explain the filter order.
checks: Apply top 10 with a region filter

days.lab_task: Create a product hierarchy, drill from category to product, build a set of top customers and compare their sales with everyone else.
Calculate profit margin correctly at aggregate level, days to ship, a customer segment label with CASE and a cleaned product name, and fix a margin calculated at row level.
checks: Aggregate margin differs from averaged row margins

subtopics: Compute using: table, pane and specific dimensions
days.lab_task: Build running totals, percent of total by region, year-over-year growth, a rank of products and a three-month moving average, and fix one with the wrong compute-using setting.
checks: Percent of total sums to 100 per region
Ranks restart per category as intended

days.lab_task: Map sales by state and city, build a dual-axis map with profit colour and sales size, add a custom geocode for store locations and load a spatial file of sales territories.

days.topic: Working with Dates and Time Series
days.lab_task: Show monthly sales as a continuous series, compare this year with last year by week, add a year-to-date calculation, set a fiscal year starting in April and add a forecast.

subtopics: Parameters in filters and reference lines
days.lab_task: Build a measure selector, a top N parameter, a target line parameter and a what-if discount calculation that shows the effect on profit.
checks: View changes measure from the control

days.lab_task: Plan and build a sales dashboard with KPIs at the top, trend and breakdown charts, shared filters, a phone layout and a fixed size.
Add a click-to-filter action from a map, highlight on hover, a set action that compares a selected region with others and a URL action to a product page.
checks: Click a region on the map

days.lab_task: Build a five-point story about a drop in profit, with annotations and captions, present it in five minutes and export it to PDF.
Restyle the sales dashboard with an accessible palette, clear tooltips with a viz in tooltip, reference lines for targets and a consistent style guide.

subtopics: Joins and their effect on counts
days.lab_task: Combine orders, returns and targets with relationships, show how a join duplicates sales, union monthly files and blend a separate targets source.
checks: Join duplicates sales and relationship does not

days.lab_task: Record performance of a slow dashboard, fix the top three problems with an aggregated extract, simpler calculations and fewer filters, and compare load time.

days.topic: Publishing and Sharing with Tableau Cloud or Server
days.lab_task: Publish the dashboard and its data source, set project permissions, schedule a refresh, subscribe a user and set a data-driven alert.
Take a timed practice exam, rebuild each wrong answer in Tableau, practise weak areas and take a second exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.lab_task: Build and publish a sales performance dashboard for a regional manager with correct calculations, a map, trends, parameters, actions and a phone layout, then present a short story of the findings.
days.deliverable: Published dashboard, story and presentation recording
checks: Filters, parameters and actions all work
Story clear and supported by the dashboard
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one dashboard

intermediate.summary: For analysts who build Tableau dashboards. Covers level of detail expressions, advanced table calculations, advanced chart types, dynamic dashboards, advanced actions, data modelling, Tableau Prep, statistics and analytics, spatial analysis, row-level security, performance tuning, dashboard design and usability, Tableau Pulse and AI features, embedding, advanced Prep flows, governance basics, extensions, calendar and cohort analysis and the Certified Data Analyst exam.
prerequisites: Builds Tableau dashboards with calculated fields, filters and actions
Publishes to Tableau Cloud or Server
outcomes: Answer complex questions with LOD expressions and advanced calculations
Model and prepare data with relationships and Tableau Prep
Build fast, secure and usable dashboards for many users
Use Tableau's AI features and pass the Certified Data Analyst exam

days.topic: Level of Detail Expressions: FIXED, INCLUDE and EXCLUDE
subtopics: Common uses: first purchase, customer totals and percent of total
days.lab_task: Find each customer's first order date, average sales per customer by region, each product's share of category sales and fix an LOD broken by a filter with a context filter.
checks: Same answer with both where possible

subtopics: Running and moving calculations with nesting
days.lab_task: Build a comparison to the previous period with LOOKUP, a window average line, a top N filter that keeps totals and debug a nested table calculation.
Build a waterfall of profit by sub-category, a Pareto of customers, a bullet chart against targets, a bump chart of product rank and small multiples of regional trends.
checks: Bars add up to total profit
One trend per region on shared axes

days.lab_task: Build a dashboard that switches between chart and table views, hides a filter panel behind a button and shows a detail section only when a mark is selected.

days.topic: Advanced Actions: Set, Parameter and Navigation
days.lab_task: Build an asymmetric drill-down with set actions, a parameter action that highlights a selected product across views and navigation between three dashboards that keeps filters.

subtopics: Logical and physical layers in depth
Published data sources as shared models
days.lab_task: Model sales and returns as a multi-fact relationship model, set cardinality, publish it as a certified data source and test totals against SQL.
days.deliverable: Data model, published source and test results

subtopics: Input, clean, aggregate, pivot, join and union steps
Outputs to files and published sources
days.lab_task: Build a Prep flow that unions monthly files, cleans customer names, pivots targets, joins returns, aggregates to monthly grain and outputs a published data source.
checks: All files included with source names
Data source available in Tableau Cloud

subtopics: Integrating Python or R with TabPy
days.lab_task: Add trend models and read their statistics, cluster customers, tune a forecast, use Explain Data on an outlier and call a Python model through TabPy.
Join customers to sales territories with a spatial join, draw delivery routes from stores to customers, find customers within 10 km of each store and redesign territories.
Restrict regional managers to their region with an entitlement table, test as several users and move the rule into a virtual connection data policy.
checks: Same results through the virtual connection

days.lab_task: Tune three slow workbooks with the recorder and optimiser, record each fix and its effect and write team performance guidelines.
Interview two users, redesign a cluttered dashboard, test both versions with three tasks and use admin views to find dashboards nobody uses.
days.deliverable: Interview notes, redesign and test results
checks: Tasks faster on the new design

days.topic: Tableau Pulse, Tableau Agent and AI Features
subtopics: Data quality and trust for AI
When AI helps and when it misleads
days.lab_task: Define three Pulse metrics with goals, subscribe users, check the generated insights against the data and use Tableau Agent to draft a calculation and a view.
days.deliverable: Metric definitions, insight checks and notes

subtopics: Authentication: connected apps and single sign-on
Filtering embedded views from the app
days.lab_task: Embed a dashboard in a web page with a connected app, pass filters from the page, react to mark selections in the page and test security for two users.
checks: Dashboard shown without a second login

subtopics: Scripts in Prep with Python or R
Error handling and data quality steps
days.lab_task: Build an incremental Prep flow that writes to a database, adds a Python cleaning script, uses a run-time parameter and alerts on failure.
Design a project and permissions structure for three departments, certify shared sources, add quality warnings, trace lineage and archive stale content.
checks: Warning shown to users of the source

days.lab_task: Add a writeback extension for comments, send dashboard alerts to Slack and list workbooks and their owners with the REST API.
days.deliverable: Extension set-up, Slack alerts and API script
checks: Saved and shown in the dashboard

days.lab_task: Build a monthly cohort retention heatmap with LODs, a calendar heatmap of orders, a 4-4-5 retail calendar comparison and validate cohort numbers against SQL.
Complete a timed practice exam with hands-on tasks, review mistakes, practise weak areas and take a second exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.lab_task: Build a customer analytics suite with a Prep flow, a certified multi-fact model, cohort and LOD analysis, advanced actions, row-level security, tuned performance and Pulse metrics, then present it to stakeholders.
days.deliverable: Flows, data source, dashboards and presentation
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one suite

advanced.summary: For senior analysts, Tableau developers and administrators. Covers Tableau Server architecture and administration, Tableau Cloud administration, identity, scaling, extract and refresh strategy, monitoring, upgrades and migration to Cloud, the REST and Metadata APIs, Hyper API automation, content migration, embedded analytics at scale, semantic layers, performance at scale, advanced visual design, enterprise governance, data culture, licensing and cost, and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Builds advanced dashboards with LODs and actions
outcomes: Administer and scale Tableau Server and Tableau Cloud
Deliver embedded and governed analytics at scale
Lead Tableau programmes, adoption and cost

days.lab_task: Install a three-node Tableau Server cluster with TSM, place processes for availability, take a backup and restore it to a test server.
days.deliverable: Topology design, install log and restore evidence
checks: Content available on the test server

days.lab_task: Create two sites with projects and groups, set schedules and backgrounder settings, use admin views to find heavy jobs and plan weekly maintenance.
days.deliverable: Configuration, admin findings and maintenance plan
checks: Backups, clean-up and log rotation included

subtopics: Authentication with SAML and identity providers
days.lab_task: Set up SAML and SCIM with an identity provider, connect a private database through Tableau Bridge, build an admin dashboard from Admin Insights and review the Activity Log.
days.deliverable: Configuration, Bridge set-up and admin dashboard
checks: Add a user in the identity provider

days.topic: Identity, Authentication and Permissions at Scale
days.lab_task: Design locked project permissions for five departments using groups only, audit current permissions with the REST API and fix exceptions.
days.deliverable: Permission design, audit report and fixes

subtopics: Load testing with TabJolt or similar
days.lab_task: Load test the server with 200 users, add nodes and node roles to separate refreshes from viewing, retest and write a DR plan.
days.deliverable: Load test results, topology changes and DR plan

days.lab_task: Review 50 refresh jobs, switch the heaviest to incremental, merge duplicate extracts into shared sources, rebalance schedules and alert on failures.
checks: Fewer extracts with the same data

days.lab_task: Set up monitoring with the Resource Monitoring Tool, alert on slow views and failed refreshes and build a monthly health report for leadership.
days.deliverable: Monitoring set-up, alerts and health report

days.topic: Upgrades and Migrating from Server to Cloud
days.lab_task: Plan a move from Tableau Server to Tableau Cloud, migrate a project with its permissions using the Content Migration Tool, fix data connections and validate dashboards.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, migration log and validation report

days.topic: Automating Tableau with the REST API and Python
days.lab_task: Write Python scripts that onboard users from a CSV, publish workbooks from Git, trigger refreshes after an upstream job and report content without owners.
checks: Workbooks published with the right project

days.lab_task: Query the Metadata API to find every dashboard using a column that will be dropped, list duplicate calculations across workbooks and generate documentation for a certified source.
days.deliverable: Queries, impact report and generated documentation

subtopics: Creating extracts with the Hyper API
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that creates and updates a Hyper extract from a data warehouse with the Hyper API, publishes it and runs on a schedule.

days.topic: Content Migration and DevOps for Tableau
days.lab_task: Set up dev, test and prod projects, promote a workbook with changed connections through a scripted pipeline, test key numbers automatically and roll back a bad release.
Embed dashboards in a multi-tenant web app using JWT with user attributes for row-level security, load test it and monitor use by tenant.
days.deliverable: App, configuration, load test and usage report

subtopics: Tableau semantics and external semantic layers
days.lab_task: Replace five workbook-specific sources with one shared model, define metrics once, connect an external semantic layer and test that all dashboards keep their numbers.
days.deliverable: Shared model, metric definitions and test results

subtopics: Initial SQL and custom SQL risks
days.lab_task: Find the ten slowest views on the platform, work through database indexes, view acceleration and design changes, and report improvements.
checks: Ten slowest listed with load times
Load time lower for eligible views
Before and after times for each view

days.topic: Advanced Visual Design and Custom Charts
days.lab_task: Build a Sankey diagram, a radial chart and an executive one-page dashboard, run a design review with peers and simplify any chart that hurts understanding.

subtopics: Governance models: centralised, delegated and self-governing
days.lab_task: Assess an organisation against Tableau Blueprint, design a governance model and a champions programme and set measures for adoption.
days.deliverable: Assessment, governance model and programme plan

subtopics: Licence types: Creator, Explorer and Viewer
Comparing Tableau with Power BI and others
days.lab_task: Review licence use, find users with the wrong licence, estimate savings, compare platform options and present a three-year analytics platform plan.
days.deliverable: Licence review, savings estimate and plan

days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected issues (an expired database credential, a backgrounder backlog, a slow view after a change, an SSO failure and a full disk), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.lab_task: Design and deliver an enterprise Tableau programme: platform set-up with identity and scaling, automated content promotion, shared models, embedded analytics, monitoring, governance and licence review, then present it to a leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Platform design, scripts, dashboards, governance plan and presentation
checks: Plan, cost and adoption measures defended
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one programme
